# Manus Documentation

## Introduction

- [Welcome](https://manus.im/docs/introduction/welcome.md): Learn about Manus and how to get started
- [Get started with Manus](https://manus.im/docs/introduction/quickstart.md): Start your first Manus task: sign in, choose a mode, describe your goal, and refine the result. Learn how credits work and how to add context.
- [Plans and Pricing](https://manus.im/docs/introduction/plans.md): Manus AI operates on a credit-based system that gives you flexibility and control over your usage. Credits are consumed based on the complexity and resources required for each task.

## Features

- [Manus features overview](https://manus.im/docs/features/overview.md): Browse Manus features by category: workflows for organizing work, capabilities inside a task, web development, and reference pages for models.

### Workflows

- [Projects](https://manus.im/docs/features/projects.md): Projects let you create persistent workspaces with shared instructions and files, so every new task starts with the right context. Organize recurring workflows, collaborate with your team, and eliminate repetitive setup.
- [Manus Skills](https://manus.im/docs/features/skills.md)
- [Automations](https://manus.im/docs/automations.md)
- [Parallel Tasks](https://manus.im/docs/features/parallel-tasks.md): Ask Manus to split your work into separate tasks and manage them from one main task. Start in a Project so that every task shares the same context.
- [Branch](https://manus.im/docs/features/branch.md): Branch lets you take any task in a new direction from any Manus reply. The new task keeps everything up to that point, and your original task stays unchanged.
- [Manus Collab](https://manus.im/docs/features/collab.md): Real-time collaboration on AI tasks—one workspace, one version, zero confusion
- [Mail Manus](https://manus.im/docs/features/mail-manus.md): Email-based task interface for Manus AI agent

### Capabilities

- [Wide Research](https://manus.im/docs/features/wide-research.md): Parallel multi-agent system for large-scale research and processing tasks.
- [Manus Slides](https://manus.im/docs/features/slides.md): Manus creates complete presentations from a simple description. It conducts research, develops content, designs slides, generates visuals, and writes detailed speaker notes—delivering presentation-ready decks in minutes.
- [Design View](https://manus.im/docs/features/design-view.md): Manus Design View is a powerful extension of the Manus agent that transforms your creative process into a seamless AI design workflow, giving you granular control over every detail.
- [Data Analysis & Visualization](https://manus.im/docs/features/data-visualization.md): Turn raw data into presentation-ready insights in minutes
- [Multimedia Processing](https://manus.im/docs/features/multi-modal.md): Generate and understand images, video, voice, and speech
- [Video Editor](https://manus.im/docs/features/video-editor.md): Make and edit videos on a multi-track timeline in Manus Studio. Start from an idea or your own footage, then refine the cut by hand or by asking Manus.
- [Meeting minutes](https://manus.im/docs/features/meeting-minutes.md)
- [Cloud browser](https://manus.im/docs/features/cloud-browser.md): Manus's cloud-based browser that operates like a real person
- [Browser Operator](https://manus.im/docs/features/browser-operator.md): A browser extension that transforms your web browser into an autonomous agent.
- [Manus Studio](https://manus.im/docs/features/desktop.md): Let Manus work on your own computer. Manus Studio gives Manus access to your files, terminal, and apps, with permission modes that keep you in control.

### Web development

- [Manus 2.0](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/getting-started.md): Build, preview, edit, and publish a website or web app with Manus 2.0. Work in the cloud or in a folder on your own computer with Manus Studio.
- [Build locally in Manus Studio](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/build-locally.md): Build websites, web apps, mobile apps, and games in a folder on your own computer with Manus Studio. Choose Manus-managed services or a plain local project.
- [Game Developer](https://manus.im/docs/features/game-developer.md): Create browser games from a playable template and a plain-language description. Edit gameplay, art, and sound in the Edit panel, host online multiplayer games on a Cloud Computer, and publish a link so others can play.
- [Editing and Previewing](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/editing-and-previewing.md): Manus lets you build and refine your web app with instant feedback and natural-language edits
- [Publishing](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/publishing.md): Build and go live
- [App Publishing (mobile)](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/app-publishing.md)
- [Usage and Pricing](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/getting-started/usage-and-pricing.md): This document outlines the billing structure for websites built with Manus. It covers how you are charged for building, hosting, and powering experiences for your users.

#### Backend and services

- [Built-in AI Capabilities](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/ai-capabilities.md): Learn how to incorporate AI capabilities into your web application
- [Cloud Infrastructure](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/cloud-infrastructure.md): Fully managed cloud infrastructure for Manus apps—backend, database, file storage, and one‑command deployment
- [Data cache](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/data-cache.md): Add a managed backend cache to your web app so that your server does slow work once and serves every visitor fast.
- [Access Control](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/access-control.md): Manage access for your web application
- [Notifications](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/notifications.md): Get real time updates on your web applications
- [Payments](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/payments.md): How to monetize your builds
- [Shopify](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/shopify.md): Build a custom storefront for your Shopify store in a Website Builder project, and manage your store from the chat with the Shopify connector.
- [Schedules](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/schedules.md)

#### Project management

- [Project Analytics ](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/project-analytics.md): Understand your users with integrated analytics, providing you with valuable insights into how users are interacting with your site
- [Custom Domains: Professionalize Your Brand](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/custom-domains.md): Your site goes live on a professional, branded URL in minutes.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/seo.md): Built-in SEO for sites created and published on Manus

#### Developer tools

- [Code Control](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/code-control.md): Get full access to your app’s code so you can copy what you need or download the entire codebase and stay fully in control.
- [Make a Copy](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/make-a-copy.md)
- [Edit in New Task](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/edit-in-new-task.md): Open an existing website or app in a new task and keep editing the same project. Run several tasks on one website at the same time.
- [Import from Figma: From Design to App in One Step](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/import-figma.md): Turn your Figma designs into a working web app by sharing links to the frame and describing what you want
- [Third-Party Integrations](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/third-party-integrations.md): Connect Stripe, Shopify, Google Maps, or any REST API—secure keys, simple natural‑language setup.
- [GitHub Integration](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/github-integration.md): Export your Manus project to a private GitHub repo, then keep working from either place. Manus and GitHub stay in step by automatically sending new changes and pulling the latest updates, so you can use your favorite coding tools without losing sync.

### Reference

- [Built-in Models](https://manus.im/docs/models/built-in-models.md): The video, image, audio, and 3D models built into Manus, what each one is for, and how to choose one. All built-in models use Manus credits.
- [Manus Flex](https://manus.im/docs/models/manus-flex.md): Run Manus with your own API key from a supported inference provider. Learn how to connect a provider, choose a model, and see who bills each cost.
- [Nano Banana Pro](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/nano-banana-pro.md): AI-powered image generation for visually stunning slides and graphics

## Integrations

- [Integrate Manus with Your Existing Tools](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/integrations.md): Connect Manus to your tools and workflows
- [Slack Integration](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/slack-integration.md): Bring Manus into your team conversations
- [Zapier ](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/zapier.md): Connect Manus to 8,000+ apps with no-code automation
- [Manus API](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/manus-api.md): Programmatic access to Manus as a complete AI agent
- [Data Sources](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/data-sources.md): Access premium third-party data APIs integrated into Manus

### Connectors

- [Connectors](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/connectors.md): Browse every connector available in Manus and learn how to connect apps, MCP servers, and APIs to your tasks.
- [MCP Connectors](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/mcp-connectors.md): Connect Manus to your team’s tools and enable context-driven creation — moving from idea to validation to live app faster than ever.
- [Custom MCP Servers](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/custom-mcp.md): Build integrations with your internal tools and proprietary systems
